_comment: Canonical cross-platform design tokens. Source of truth for the 10 semantic color roles shared by all four surfaces (iOS Asset Catalog colorsets, android theme/Theme.kt, web/static/index.html CSS vars, frontend/src/index.css CSS vars). tools/test_theme_alignment.py fails CI if any platform drifts from these values. Surface colors (background/card/border/text) are platform-idiomatic and intentionally not enforced here — iOS uses system adaptive colors. Light green is #15803D (not #16A34A) for WCAG AA on white; dark onPrimary is #111827 because white on the dark-mode blue #5B8DEF fails AA.
